digest.component_or_area: gates subsystem (plan-review and completion close gates)
propositions: gate_enabled must raise ConfigError (chained from parse fault, naming gate label and ticket) instead of returning GateState.UNREADABLE when rebar.toml is malformed or unreadable
claim and close operations fail loudly with the ConfigError before any work proceeds, leaving ticket state unchanged (open or in_progress respectively)
GateState.UNREADABLE enum state is removed as unreachable; ENABLED/DISABLED remain and bool monkeypatch compatibility is preserved
CLI main() gains an except ConfigError boundary to render config faults as clean Error: <msg> exit-1 failures to the operator instead of tracebacks
no gate work or config I/O occurs under the write lock on the unreadable path; pre-lock check errors first
